content: dart_ipc 2.0.2 (monkeyWie, ~Sep 2026, pure Dart + win32 FFI): socket-compatible API — named pipe on Windows, unix socket on Unix; 150 pub points; works with json_rpc_2. Rust counterpart: interprocess 2.4.8 (Nov 2026, tokio) provides local sockets = named pipes on Windows / UDS on Unix. FlClash desktop uses UDS on Linux/macOS + named pipe on Windows with a JSON envelope.
